title: Honor explicit GEMINI_MODELS without silent downgrades
context_summary: Configured Gemini models returned 404 errors in production agent_runs #74-#78.
observation: normalizeGeminiModelName rewrote newer configured models to deprecated gemini-2.5-flash.
verified_action: Strip optional models/ prefix only, deduplicate cleanly, and respect explicit GEMINI_MODELS env configuration.
